reason: I already have a site and my manager updates the menu when it matters; moving everything to a new site for 25 euros a month is a hassle I don't need right now. Most of my customers see us on Glovo and Google anyway.
objection: Switching means a new site, new QR codes, possibly losing what we have, and someone has to set it up. And we all use Viber here, not WhatsApp, so my staff wouldn't even use it.
would_change_my_mind: If it worked on top of my existing site without moving anything and my manager could do it from Viber, with a free first month to see it actually saves time.
